title: Tarot Batch C part 2: two migrations applied, four functions deployed, migration history repaired
ownerApproval: Owner approved in chat on 2026-11-24 ('Duyệt áp và deploy'): apply the two migrations named by SHA-256 in PLAN.md (Tarot ba tầng section) and deploy ai-tarot-reading, admin-model-router-config, admin-model-campaigns, share-events.
sourceNote: Merge of PR 65 on main; local main equalled origin/main when the migrations were applied and the functions deployed.

migrations.method: npx --yes supabase@3.1.0 db query --yes --remote=etfajmrwyywokgafzxsb -f <file>, one file at a time in this order, stop on error (run by Claude); both files exited 0. Then npx supabase@3.1.0 migration repair --status applied 20261124090000 20261124090100 --remote=etfajmrwyywokgafzxsb --yes.

postApplyChecks.readOnlyQuery: supabase db query --read-only: tables model_campaigns and model_campaign_variants exist with RLS on; all 9 public functions created by the migrations exist (admin_get_model_campaign_metrics, admin_list_model_campaigns, admin_pick_model_campaign_winner, admin_save_model_campaign_draft, admin_set_model_campaign_status, publish_model_route_config, runtime_model_campaign_for_feature, set_ai_feature_switch, tarot_note_claim); supabase_migrations.schema_migrations has rows 20261124090000 and 20261124090100.

functions.method: npx --yes supabase@3.1.0 functions deploy ai-tarot-reading admin-model-router-config admin-model-campaigns share-events --remote=etfajmrwyywokgafzxsb --use-api --yes (run by Claude)
